capabilities: Draws a staggered grid of circles for every week or day of your life
Creates week and day notes from plain-text templates
Colors each note with an editable square or image
Attaches photos or videos when creating a note
Exports and imports all settings as one code
extras: Network use is limited to the optional Immich picker and Import config from a pasted URL; no telemetry. The exported config code contains the Immich API key, and the key is stored in plain text in data.json, so the README advises a read-only key.
problem: Obsidian has no visual grid that maps every week or day of your life to a note you can color and open.

relations.evidence: the "Create week file" dialog can show that week's photos so you can pick some to attach

summary: Life-in-weeks grid journal that draws your life as colored circles, each linked to a week or day note.
